integrity: Closed-form algebraic proof supplemented by a standalone symbolic and spectral-diagnostic script, with source comparisons and publication-priority caveats.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric uniform-stationary walks on the specified tree; no nonsymmetric walks or deeper trees; finite verification is not a proof of all parameters; independent audit not performed.
scientific_scope: Unique unrestricted symmetric stochastic Kemeny minimization on the specified two-bough three-generation trees for all integers m, ell >=2, exact three-phase holding support and integer cutoffs.
title: A quadratic three-phase holding law for Kemeny-optimal walks on three-generation two-bough trees
